items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: he started me on the horn... Don't go play with nobody... he was very determined in teaching here. And he had very much patience. He would give you a lesson

ctx.x: No, he didn't have no book. It actually was a year training from the other room. What she was doing I'm supposed to detect me, tell him whether it was a minor or a major. He would have me guessing whether she was playing in sharps or flats. You see, about a year training from that time. But I hadn't even touched the horn as yet. And he started me on the horn and after I got up away, he told me that, Don't go play with nobody. Better than a year, two years before he would let me play with anybody. And then when I…

Oh, interrupted. About those lessons, I was interested since Mr. Matriya is gone. We did talk to his widow and daughter. Yeah. And they told us quite a bit about him. But I wondered in his teaching, did he use a certain method? What method do you remember?
Well, I'll tell you one thing he was. Yes, he was very determined in teaching here. And he had very much patience. He would give you a lesson and...
